# atlantio

# atlantio

Read, write and manipulate
[Atlantis](https://research.csiro.au/atlantis/) model inputs and
outputs. `atlantio` provides an S7 class `Atlantis` that represents an
Atlantis model, functions to read and write Atlantis files, and methods
to extract diet tables, food webs and time series from a model.

## Installation

`atlantio` is not on CRAN yet. Install the development version from
GitHub with [pak](https://pak.r-lib.org/):

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("inSileco/atlantio")
```

## Usage

``` r

library(atlantio)
mod <- new_atlantis() |>
  atlantis_load_files(c(
    atlantis_examples("outputs", "output.nc"),
    atlantis_examples("outputs", "outputBiomIndx.txt"),
    atlantis_examples("outputs", "outputBoxBiomass.txt")
  ))
mod

# ── Atlantis Model ──
# 
# ── Data availability: 
# ✖ Geometry (BGM)
# ✖ Run file
# ✖ Biology parameters
# ✖ Group file
# ✔ Main output
# ✖ Diet data
# ✖ Detailed diet data
# ✔ Biomass (system-wide)
# ✔ Biomass (per box)
# ✖ Biomass (per age)
# 
# ── Main output details: 
# • 139 variables
# • 74 time steps
```

See the package vignettes for details on reading models, listing
parameters and calibration workflows.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`Atlantis()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/Atlantis.md) :
  Atlantis Ecosystem Model Container
- [`aggregate_time_series()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/aggregate_time_series.md)
  : Aggregate age-structured tracers over boxes and layers
- [`apply_parameters()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/apply_parameters.md)
  : Apply a set of calibrated values to an Atlantis object
- [`atlantio`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/atlantio-package.md)
  [`atlantio-package`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/atlantio-package.md)
  : atlantio: Read, Write and Manipulate Atlantis Model Inputs and
  Outputs
- [`atlantis_examples()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/atlantis_examples.md)
  : Helper function to quickly access example files.
- [`atlantis_load_files()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/atlantis_load_files.md)
  : Load Atlantis files into model object
- [`atlantis_supported_versions`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/atlantis_supported_versions.md)
  : Atlantis versions supported by atlantio
- [`check_init()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/check_init.md)
  : Check an Atlantis initial-conditions file
- [`check_prm()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/check_prm.md) :
  Check Atlantis parameter files
- [`check_run()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/check_run.md) :
  Check that an Atlantis run completed
- [`compare_prm()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/compare_prm.md)
  : Compare two Atlantis parameter files
- [`create_diet_table()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/create_diet_table.md)
  : Create a diet table
- [`create_foodweb()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/create_foodweb.md)
  : Create a food web
- [`create_time_series()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/create_time_series.md)
  : Create time series from the main output
- [`create_time_series_biomass()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/create_time_series_biomass.md)
  : Create biomass time series
- [`generate_calibration_table()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/generate_calibration_table.md)
  : Generate a calibration table
- [`generate_file()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/generate_file.md)
  : Generate parameter files
- [`get_biomass_by_type()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/get_biomass_by_type.md)
  : Extract biomass data by aggregation type
- [`input_files`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/input_files.md)
  : Input files
- [`inverse_transform_parameter_value()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/inverse_transform_parameter_value.md)
  : Map a parameter value from the file scale back to the calibration
  scale
- [`list_atlantis_parameters()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/list_atlantis_parameters.md)
  : List Atlantis parameters for a given Atlantis version
- [`new_atlantis()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/new_atlantis.md)
  : Create new Atlantis model object
- [`parameters_hints`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/parameters_hints.md)
  : Parameter Hints for Atlantis Model Configuration
- [`read_atlantis_files()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/read_atlantis_files.md)
  [`read_bgm()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/read_atlantis_files.md)
  [`read_nc()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/read_atlantis_files.md)
  [`read_group_file()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/read_atlantis_files.md)
  [`read_prm_files()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/read_atlantis_files.md)
  [`read_txt_files()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/read_atlantis_files.md)
  [`read_xml()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/read_atlantis_files.md)
  : Read Atlantis inputs and outputs files
- [`read_biomass_index()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/read_biomass_index.md)
  : Read the biomass of the living groups from the Atlantis biomass
  index
- [`read_calibration_runs()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/read_calibration_runs.md)
  : Read the parameter values of calibration runs
- [`read_prm()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/read_prm.md)
  [`write_prm()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/read_prm.md) :
  Parse .prm file contents into structured list
- [`score_table()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/score_table.md)
  [`compute_score()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/score_table.md)
  : Calibration objective: deviation from the initial state
- [`set_init_values()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/set_init_values.md)
  : Set the values of a variable of an Atlantis initial-conditions file
- [`summarise_calibration()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/summarise_calibration.md)
  : Summarise the parameter values of a calibration
- [`transform_parameter_value()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/transform_parameter_value.md)
  : Transform a parameter value
- [`window_values()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/window_values.md)
  : Values of a series scored over the last years of a run
- [`write_parameter_folder()`](https://insileco.io/atlantio/reference/write_parameter_folder.md)
  : Write a complete Atlantis parameter folder
